title: Safer Sex
summary: Safer sex means lowering the risk of STIs and unplanned pregnancy: barriers (condoms, dental dams), regular testing, vaccines, PrEP, open talk with partners and clear consent.
do: Use a condom or barrier every time
Get HPV and hepatitis B vaccines
dont: Assume someone has no STI because they look healthy
